name: Basic Instinct
description: Movement speed, damage dealt, and healing potency are increased. Mighty Guard will not reduce damage dealt while Basic Instinct is in effect.
effects: Movement speed, damage dealt, and healing potency are increased. Mighty Guard will not reduce damage dealt while Basic Instinct is in effect.

source_abilities.name: Basic Instinct
source_abilities.description:
Increases movement speed by 30%, and healing potency and damage dealt by 100%. Also ignores the damage penalty inflicted by Mighty Guard.
Can only be used in duties intended for two or more players while playing alone, while no other party members are in the instance, or when all party members are incapacitated. Effect ends when joined by one or more party members.
